title: Genetic and Environmental Overlap Between Internalizing Psychopathology, Childhood Family Conditions, and Adult Life Events
description:
This dataset contains data from 918 individuals comprising 459 twin pairs who participated in a study examining genetic and environmental influences on internalizing psychopathology and their associations with childhood family conditions and adult life events. The dataset includes measures of depression, panic, agoraphobia, social phobia, and generalized anxiety, as well as indicators of childhood family conditions and adult life events. Demographic and zygosity information relevant to the analyses is also included. Variable names and coding are documented in the accompanying codebook.
The data were used for multivariate behavioral genetic analyses examining the genetic and environmental overlap between internalizing symptoms and contextual experiences.
